### You Can't Out-Give God
Author: Rick Warren
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/daily-hope-with-rick-warren/you-can-t-out-give-god-daily-hope-with-rick-warren-dec-22-2015.html
Passage: Deuteronomy 15:10
Points:
- God promises to bless those who practice heartfelt generosity in all areas of life.
- Believers must resist a grudging mindset and avoid withholding help from others.
- Generosity applies not only to finances, but also to time, energy, and encouragement.
- Giving sacrificially breaks the power of materialism and fosters Christlike character.
- Trusting God's promises in giving allows believers to experience the joy of His abundant provision.

### Reasons for Poverty
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier.org
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/reasons-poverty
Passage: Deuteronomy 15:11
Points:
- God commands His people to show open-handed compassion toward those in need.
- Neither wealth nor poverty is inherently moral; virtue depends on the heart's devotion.
- Effective Christian compassion requires discerning the underlying causes of a person's hardship.
- Believers are called to provide relief to victims of tragedy and advocate for the exploited.
- Faithful stewardship involves using financial resources and personal gifts to advance God's kingdom.
